description: Adds a message to your conversation. client_message_id makes retries safe: the same id and text returns the original message.

client_message_id.description: Required idempotency key, unique per conversation. Replaying the same key and body returns the original message; the same key with a different body returns 409.

conversation_token.description: conversation_token returned once by start_conversation. Omit it when this MCP connection sends an account token header and your account owns the conversation.

message.description: Follow-up message text. Max 4000 characters and 10240 UTF-8 bytes.

name: send_message
title: Send a follow-up message
